_doc.block_overrides: Map of filename substrings to ASTC block size. Applied before edge_energy analysis.
_doc.excludes: List of filename substrings. Matching files are NEVER converted (left as PNG).
_doc.block_sizes: 4x4 = best quality (sprites/characters), 6x6 = good quality, 8x8 = default, 10x10 = smooth backgrounds only
